aiVerification.summary: The workbook supports a new frame mold function-check validation, but the draft uses an invalid filename-based changed factor and insufficient row citations for the measured results.
issues: Changed factor is incorrectly named from the source filename instead of the cited report context.
Baseline condition is not evidenced; the file appears to be a one-arm validation of a new mold rather than an explicit baseline-vs-test comparison.
Changed condition should be stated as frame new mold / new mold improvement for NG function, supported by title, purpose, and decision rows.
Outcome evidence cites mainly header row Sheet1!13 and omits the actual result rows needed to support the measurement/statistical values.
Subresult sampleCount is 7, but the visible cited context only includes a subset of data rows, so row-level support for the statistics is incomplete.
Row Sheet1!12 should be included with Sheet1!13 because the metric headers span both rows.
Decision row Sheet1!25 is relevant evidence for the validation conclusion and should be included in the case evidence.
requiredUserQuestions: Is there an old-mold or baseline result file to compare against?
correctionPlan: Rename the changed factor to a source-supported factor such as Frame new mold improvement for NG function.
Set baselineCondition to not provided or no explicit old-mold baseline in this workbook.
Set changedCondition to frame new mold / new mold sample checked for speaker function.
Use title, purpose, content, result header, actual result data rows, and decision rows as evidence.
Add Sheet1!12 and all actual result rows used for the 7-sample statistics to comparisonRows and subResult evidenceRows.
Do not cite only Sheet1!13 for numeric statistics; each statistic must cite the rows containing the underlying values.
Keep the Sigma, Hearing voltage, and Total NG rate outcomes under the same new-mold validation context.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current evidence row citations prove source-row existence and general new-mold context, but they are not sufficient for final Ask AI evidence because the numeric outcomes lack citations to the underlying data rows.
